Subsidence and fusion performance of a 3D-printed porous interbody cage with stress-optimized body lattice and microporous endplates - a comprehensive mechanical and biological analysis.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Guy Fogel, Nicholas Martin, Kelli Lynch, Matthew H Pelletier, Daniel Wills et al. The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society 2022-06-01 10.1016/j.spinee.2022.01.003
单位: Spine Pain Begone Clinic, 2833 Babcock Rd Suite 306, San Antonio, TX 78229, USA.
通讯: Yun Peng @ NuVasive, 7475 Lusk Blvd., San Diego, CA 92129, USA. Electronic address: ypeng@nuvasive.com.
相关性: 该论文直接研究了3D打印多孔钛椎间融合器的力学性能和骨整合，与您的AM生物医学方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing or surface roughness characterization of as-built LPBF surfaces.
动机· 评估3D打印多孔钛椎间融合器设计对下沉和融合性能的影响
方法· 采用ASTM标准机械测试和绵羊脊柱融合模型，对比不同多孔设计
结果· 多孔体和微孔端板有效降低融合器刚度，促进早期融合和骨长入
验证· 机械测试结合绵羊体内融合模型的综合验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the contribution of stress-optimized body lattice and microporous endplates in 3D-printed titanium interbody cages to stiffness reduction and subsidence resistance for spinal fusion.
Method· Four cage designs with two-by-two combinations of body lattice and microporous endplates were tested under ASTM static compression and subsidence, and an ovine interbody fusion model was used for in vivo analysis.
Result· Both porous features reduced cage stiffness by ~17% each; the microporous endplates significantly reduced block stiffness by 24.9%, and all cages in the animal model achieved rigid fusion with bone ingrowth at 12 weeks.
Validation· Validation combined ASTM F2077 and F2267 mechanical testing with an ovine interbody fusion model including radiographic, histologic, and robotic ROM assessments.

Choice of Spinal Interbody Fusion Cage Material and Design Influences Subsidence and Osseointegration Performance.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Guy Fogel, Nicholas Martin, Gregory M Williams, Jesse Unger, Christian Yee-Yanagishita et al. World neurosurgery 2022-06-01 10.1016/j.wneu.2022.03.087
单位: Spine Pain Begone Clinic, San Antonio, Texas, USA.
通讯: Yun Peng @ NuVasive Inc., San Diego, California, USA. Electronic address: ypeng@nuvasive.com.
相关性: 这篇论文直接研究了3D打印多孔钛合金椎间融合器的力学性能和骨整合，与您的AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
边界: Does not focus on hip implant or femoral stem stress shielding, but spinal cage; however, core to AM biomedical materials direction with LPBF, mechanical testing, and osseointegration.
动机· 比较不同材料和设计的椎间融合器对沉降和骨整合的影响。
方法· 对三种融合器进行力学测试和羊骨植入模型评估。
结果· 多孔钛融合器沉降位移最小且骨整合最好。
验证· 力学测试和动物组织学验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Quantify the effect of cage material and design on subsidence and osseointegration performance.
Method· Evaluated solid PEEK, solid titanium, and 3D-printed porous titanium cages via mechanical testing (stiffness, subsidence, push-out) and an ovine bone implantation model with histology.
Result· Porous titanium cages demonstrated the least dynamic subsidence displacement and supported bony ingrowth with the highest push-out shear stress at 12 weeks.
Validation· Mechanical tests (stiffness, subsidence compression, push-out) and histological analysis from an in vivo ovine model.

Osseointegration of two types of titanium cylinders with geometric or trabecular microarchitecture: A nanotomographic and histomorphometric study.

相关性: 该论文直接研究增材制造钛合金植入物的骨整合，但缺乏力学性能测试和应力屏蔽分析，与用户研究方向部分相关。
边界: The paper does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding quantification, or surface roughness characterization.
动机· 比较几何孔与仿小梁微孔钛柱的骨整合效果
方法· LPBF制备多孔钛柱，HF/HNO3清洗后植入母羊股骨髁90和270天
结果· 两种孔形骨整合无显著差异，骨整合仅局限于外周数毫米
验证· 动物体内植入后纳米CT和组织形态计量学分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the osseointegration of additively manufactured porous titanium cylinders with geometric pores versus trabecular-like microarchitecture.
Method· Cylinders were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion, cleaned with HF/HNO3, implanted in ovine femoral condyles for 90 and 270 days, and analyzed by nanoCT and histomorphometry.
Result· No significant differences in bone volume or bone-implant interface were found between pore types; mineralization rates decreased over time, and osseointegration was limited to the peripheral millimeters.
Validation· Validation was performed through in vivo animal implantation with nanoCT and histomorphometric analysis.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare osseointegration of 3D-printed porous titanium cages without bone graft versus PEEK cages with autograft in an in vivo model.
Method· Interbody cages were implanted in an ovine lumbar fusion model, and osseointegration was evaluated using microCT and histology at 4 and 8 weeks.
Result· 3D-printed titanium cages demonstrated significantly greater bone-implant contact and osseous interdigitation compared to PEEK cages.
Validation· In vivo animal study with quantitative histomorphometry and microCT analysis.

Amanda Heimbrook, Cambre Kelly, Ken Gall Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2022-06-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2022.105208
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science, Duke University, Box 90300 Hudson Hall, Durham, NC, 27708, USA. Electronic address: amanda.heimbrook@duke.edu.
通讯: Amanda Heimbrook @ Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science, Duke University, Box 90300 Hudson Hall, Durham, NC, 27708, U
相关性: 该论文研究了3D打印表面形貌对植入物排斥阻力的影响，对骨骼植入物稳定性设计有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳行为。
边界: This paper does not cover stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or stiffness matching of porous implants; it focuses on expulsion resistance as a function of surface topography and normal force.
动机· 研究3D打印表面形貌和法向力对植入物排斥阻力的影响。
方法· 在不同法向力下对具有不同表面结构的3D打印金属样品进行排斥测试。
结果· 发现表面结构可提高排斥阻力达10倍，且存在非线性交叉现象。
验证· 在合成Sawbone上进行机械排斥测试。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how 3D printed surface topography and applied normal force influence the expulsion resistance of metallic implants.
Method· Expulsion tests were conducted on 3D printed metallic samples with varied surface structures under increasing normal forces using synthetic Sawbone.
Result· Certain surface structures enhanced expulsion resistance up to 10-fold compared to polished controls, and nonlinear crossover effects were observed depending on normal force.
Validation· Mechanical expulsion testing using synthetic bone surrogate material.

Additive manufacturing of Zn-Mg alloy porous scaffolds with enhanced osseointegration: In vitro and in vivo studies.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Save for project in_vivo Exp. validation
Yu Qin, Aobo Liu, Hui Guo, Yunong Shen, Peng Wen et al. Acta biomaterialia 2022-06-01 10.1016/j.actbio.2022.03.055
单位: The State Key Laboratory of Tribology, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China; Department of Mechanical Engineering, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China.
通讯: Peng Wen @ The State Key Laboratory of Tribology, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China; Department of Mechanical Engineering,  |  DanDan Xia @ Department of Dental Materials, Peking University School and Hospital of Stomatology, Beijing 100081, China; National En  |  Yufeng Zheng @ School of Materials Science and Engineering, Peking University, Beijing 100871, China. Electronic address: yfzheng@pku.e
相关性: 该论文通过LPBF制造Zn-Mg合金多孔支架，并与松质骨刚度匹配，同时进行了体内外骨整合评价，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: No fatigue testing, no explicit surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization, and stress shielding is only indirectly addressed via elastic modulus matching.
动机· 结合增材制造与可降解金属，制备兼具定制结构和生物活性的骨植入体。
方法· 采用激光粉末床熔融（L-PBF）制备Zn-xMg多孔支架，并系统研究Mg含量对性能的影响。
结果· Zn-1Mg支架的抗压强度和弹性模量分别达40.9 MPa和1.17 GPa，与松质骨相当，且体内骨形成增强。
验证· 通过体外细胞实验和兔股骨植入12周后的组织学分析验证骨整合效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This work aims to combine additive manufacturing with biodegradable metals to produce bone implants that address both the need for personalized structures and bioactive function.
Method· Zn-xMg alloy porous scaffolds were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion using pre-alloyed powders, and the effects of Mg content on microstructure, mechanical properties, corrosion, and biocompatibility were systematically investigated.
Result· The Zn-1Mg scaffold achieved compressive strength of 40.9 MPa and elastic modulus of 1.17 GPa, matching cancellous bone, and enhanced bone formation was observed in vivo compared to pure Zn.
Validation· Validation included in vitro biocompatibility assays and histological analysis after 6- and 12-week implantation in rabbit femurs.

Chengde Gao, Chuanzhi Li, Shuping Peng, Cijun Shuai Chinese Journal of Mechanical Engineering Additive Manufacturing Frontiers 2022-06-01 10.1016/j.cjmeam.2022.100022
单位: State Key Laboratory of High Performance Complex Manufacturing, College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Central South University, Changsha, 410083, China
通讯: Shuping Peng @ Department of Regenerative Medicine & Cell Biology, Medical University of South Carolina, Charleston, SC 29425, USA  |  Cijun Shuai @ Institute of Additive Manufacturing, Jiangxi University of Science and Technology, Nanchang, 330013, China
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备的Zn-Mg-Ag合金的螺旋共晶结构增强力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡，与用户研究方向的部分相关但非直接。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are the core focus of the user's AM biomedical materials direction.
动机· 纯锌力学性能不足，需增强以用于骨植入物。
方法· 通过SLM制备Zn-Mg-Ag合金，构建螺旋共晶结构。
结果· Zn-3Mg-1Ag合金抗压强度达309 MPa，应变27%。
验证· 压缩力学测试和MG-63细胞相容性实验。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Pure Zn lacks sufficient mechanical strength and plasticity for bone implants, motivating the construction of spiral eutectic structures via SLM.
Method· Zn-Mg-Ag alloys were fabricated by selective laser melting, forming a spiral eutectic phase of alternating α-Zn and MgZn2.
Result· The Zn-3Mg-1Ag alloy exhibited a compressive strength of 309 ± 15 MPa and a strain of 27%, with enhanced dislocation pinning and crack deflection.
Validation· Mechanical compression tests and in vitro MG-63 cell biocompatibility assays confirmed the improved properties.

Comparison of the design maps of TPMS based bone scaffolds using a computational modeling framework simultaneously considering various conditions

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Save for project simulation_case
Yongtao Lü, Yi Huo, Jia’ao Zou, Yanchen Li, Zhuoyue Yang et al. Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part H Journal of Engineering in Medicine 2022-06-01 10.1177/09544119221102704
单位: DUT-BSU Joint Institute, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian, China
通讯: Chengwei Wu @ Department of Engineering Mechanics, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian, China
相关性: 该论文通过计算框架系统研究了TPMS骨支架的设计图谱，考虑了增材制造约束、生物需求和结构各向异性，与用户对多孔结构应力遮挡和刚度匹配的研究方向直接相关。
边界: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or surface roughness/osseointegration characterization.
动机· TPMS支架设计图谱不明确，缺乏同时考虑增材制造约束、生物需求和结构各向异性的方法。
方法· 开发了一个计算框架，对五种TPMS拓扑结构（Diamond, Gyroid, Fischer-Koch S, F-RD, Schwarz P）进行设计图谱分析。
结果· 孔隙率增加时表面积体积比范围减小；AM最小壁厚约束影响大于孔径约束；Schwarz P在低孔隙率时弹性模量范围最宽，Gyroid可实现高孔隙率低模量。
验证· 通过数值模拟计算不同拓扑和孔隙率下的有效弹性模量，并与文献数据对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop an efficient computational modeling framework for investigating the design maps of TPMS-based bone scaffolds that simultaneously consider additive manufacturing constraints, biological requirements, and structural anisotropy.
Method· A computational framework was developed to analyze five TPMS topologies (Diamond, Gyroid, Fischer-Koch S, F-RD, Schwarz P) and generate design maps for surface-to-volume ratio and effective elastic modulus under varying porosity and AM constraints.
Result· Increasing porosity reduces the design range of surface-to-volume ratio; minimal structural thickness for AM has a greater effect than pore size constraint; Schwarz P offers the widest elastic modulus range at low porosity (0.5-0.7), while Gyroid achieves both high porosity and low modulus (0.61 GPa at porosity 0.90).
Validation· The computational framework was validated by comparing effective elastic modulus results with literature data for TPMS scaffolds.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the long-term survival and functional outcomes of the CLS Spotorno femoral stem through a systematic review of clinical studies.
Method· A systematic review of 14 retrospective studies with pooled analysis of revision rates, subsidence, and Harris Hip Scores.
Result· The CLS Spotorno stem demonstrated excellent long-term survival (93.8% overall survival) and good functional outcomes (mean HHS 88.65), comparable to Corail and Exeter stems.
Validation· Clinical validation through pooled analysis of retrospective cohort studies with mean follow-up of 17.1 years.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how densification of cancellous bone with bone particles affects the friction coefficient at the bone-implant interface to enhance primary stability.
Method· Friction coefficients of densified and native cancellous bone samples from femoral heads were measured, and micro-CT was used to quantify the densification level.
Result· Densification increased BV/TV by up to 30.5% and static friction coefficient by up to 10.5% to 0.43.
Validation· Ex vivo mechanical testing on human cancellous bone samples.

Motivation· To reduce mechanical mismatch between bone and metallic implants by modifying internal geometry to achieve lower stiffness.
Method· Finite element simulations of uniaxial compression on cubes with different internal gap shapes (square, hexagonal, octagonal, circular).

Motivation· To compare the five-year clinical and radiographic outcomes of standard versus short fit-and-fill femoral stems in a Japanese population.
Method· A retrospective review of 100 standard-stem and 100 short-stem total hip arthroplasties was conducted, evaluating radiographs for stress shielding, bone remodeling, and JOA scores.
Result· No significant difference in stress shielding or JOA scores was found, with some differences in radiolucent lines and cortical hypertrophy between groups.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with radiographic evaluation and statistical analysis of patient outcomes.

方法· 前瞻性纳入356例患者，根据骶骨倾斜度变化分类脊柱-骨盆活动度，采用回归分析评估误差风险。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the accuracy of an optical computer-assisted surgery navigation system and determine whether abnormal spinopelvic mobility increases the risk of acetabular component placement error in total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A prospective cohort of 356 primary THA patients was enrolled; spinopelvic mobility was categorized based on sacral slope change from standing to sitting, and logistic regression was used to assess error risk.
Result· Hypermobile spinopelvic mobility significantly increased error rates for both anteversion and inclination, while stiff mobility increased error for anteversion only.
Validation· Clinical validation by comparing navigation measurements with postoperative 3D radiological reconstruction.

Motivation· To evaluate the midterm outcomes of using customized 3D-printed titanium augments combined with tantalum trabecular cups for large acetabular bone defects in revision THA.
Method· A retrospective study of 23 patients with Paprosky type III defects, comparing preoperative and postoperative hip rotation centers and functional scores at an average follow-up of 4.7 years.
Result· Postoperative rotation centers were comparable to contralateral hips, and Harris Hip Score improved from 33.5 to 86.1, with no re-revisions.

Motivation· To preoperatively predict changes in pelvic tilt following total hip arthroplasty using spinal-pelvic parameters.
Method· A case-control study classifying 135 patients into groups based on postoperative pelvic tilt and comparing preoperative sacral slope and PI-LL values.

Validation· Clinical validation on 135 patients with preoperative and one-year postoperative radiographic measurements.

Motivation· To develop a reliable radiographic method for measuring true femoral offset by aligning femoral rotation using greater trochanter landmarks.

Motivation· To develop hybrid fiber-reinforced hydrogel scaffolds for enhanced wound healing applications.
Method· Hybrid scaffolds were fabricated by combining melt electrowriting of fiber meshes with gel casting of photocrosslinkable gelatin hydrogels loaded with growth factor microspheres and bioactive glass particles.

Validation· In vivo wound healing in a rat model with histological analysis was used for validation.
